_meta.description: Comparative CVR-protection and CRM-mandate records. regime_class is the project's central analytic distinction and rests on original-language statutory reading, not on English summaries. No field may be null: an unestablished value must carry the explicit NOT-DOCUMENTED marker so a reader can tell 'no protection' from 'not established'.
_meta.regime_class_note: express-bar = statute prohibits evidentiary use of recorder material. separation-principle = investigation is procedurally separated from liability but no express evidentiary bar exists. judicial-seizure = recorders pass through judicial custody before technical investigators obtain access. discretionary = release governed by general disclosure exemptions rather than an aviation-specific rule.

instrument.note: Statutory sections carried from the briefs; not re-read against the US Code in the external rounds.

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Public disclosure of CVR recordings barred; transcript released at public hearing

cvr_evidentiary_bar.value: Discovery of the recording barred by §1154

crm_mandate.value: 14 CFR 121.404, created by the final rule at 60 FR 65940

crm_mandate_first_date.value: 1995-12-20 (effective 1996-03-19); compliance credit cut-offs 19 March 1998 for flightcrew and 19 March 1999 for flight attendants and dispatchers

instrument.value: Canadian Transportation Accident Investigation and Safety Board Act, s.28

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: s.28(2) prohibits communication or production of an on-board recording except as the section allows

cvr_evidentiary_bar.value: Privileged; a court or coroner may order production only after in-camera examination where the public interest in the proper administration of justice outweighs the privilege (s.28(6))

crm_mandate_first_date.value: Effective 31 January 2019, compliance extended to 30 September 2019

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Art. 28 permits the Committee to withhold information whose disclosure could affect accurate investigation, national security, or personal privacy; a 2013 amendment bars disclosure of the names of persons connected with the accident

cvr_evidentiary_bar.value: None. Art. 30 requires only that accident investigation be conducted separately from judicial procedures relating to civil and criminal liability, administrative disposition, and administrative appeal
cvr_evidentiary_bar.note: This is the finding: a separation principle, not an evidentiary bar. It is the sharpest contrast in the comparison and rests on the Korean text, since the government English service is expressly non-official.

instrument.value: 運輸安全委員会設置法 and 航空法

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Access controlled through Information Disclosure Act Article 5, items 3, 5 and 6, rather than an aviation-specific rule
cvr_disclosure_bar.note: Item 3 is a distinct ground and its omission understated the exemption's breadth. Corrected 18 August 2026 against an administrative appeals record on a recorder-data request, in which the Transport Safety Board also stated it had returned the data to its owner after publishing the report.

cvr_evidentiary_bar.value: No express bar located in the Japanese text
cvr_evidentiary_bar.note: An absence claim. Established partly through non-official translation and therefore carries lower confidence than a positive finding. Must be rendered as 'no express bar was located', never as 'no bar exists'.

instrument.value: UU No. 1 Tahun 2009 tentang Penerbangan, Pasal 357, 359, 360

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Pasal 359(2) permits announcement only of non-confidential results; the Penjelasan expressly names the cockpit voice recorder and its verbatim transcript among protected records

cvr_evidentiary_bar.value: Pasal 359(1): investigation results cannot be used as evidence in judicial proceedings
cvr_evidentiary_bar.note: The clearest express bar in the corpus, and doubly protective: inadmissible under 359(1) and confidential under 359(2) with the CVR named in the elucidation. No official English translation exists.

instrument.value: Code des transports art. L1621-11; Code de procédure pénale arts. 97 and 163; professional secrecy under L1621-16

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Safety investigation personnel bound by professional secrecy (L1621-16, referencing Penal Code art. 226-13)

cvr_evidentiary_bar.value: No bar. Where a judicial inquiry is opened, recorders are first seized by the judicial authority under CPP arts. 97 and 163, and technical investigators then copy the contents under the supervision of a judicial police officer
cvr_evidentiary_bar.note: The inverse of the express-bar model: the criminal track has custody first and the safety investigation works from a copy.

criminal_use.value: Recorder-derived material is available to the criminal track by design

instrument.value: Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica arts. 88-A to 88-R, introduced by Lei 12.970/2014

cvr_evidentiary_bar.value: Art. 88-I §2 limits use of voluntarily provided SIPAER material as evidence in judicial and administrative proceedings; art. 88-K governs judicial authorisation for access

criminal_use.value: Scheme upheld as constitutional in ADI 5667; the STF declared arts. 88-C, 88-D, 88-I §2, 88-K, 88-N and 88-P constitutional
criminal_use.note: Brazil is the only jurisdiction in the corpus whose CVR-protection scheme has been tested and upheld against a constitutional challenge.

crm_mandate.value: IAC 060-1002, Treinamento em Gerenciamento de Recursos de Equipes

crm_mandate_first_date.value: 2003-07-18; approving Portaria DAC 905/STE published in DOU 116 of 18 June 2003

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Records shall not be made available or used for purposes other than safety investigation
cvr_disclosure_bar.note: Currently attributed via a secondary summary in one brief; relink to EUR-Lex before rendering.

crm_mandate.value: Commission Regulation (EU) No 965/2012, Part-ORO, ORO.FC.115, succeeding JAR-OPS 1 Subpart N via EU-OPS
crm_mandate.note: Succession chain established; the ORO instrument itself is not yet a separate source record.

instrument.note: Rule 17 reported as prohibiting public disclosure of CVR and airborne image recordings; the sub-rule numbering is unconfirmed.

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Reported statutory prohibition on public disclosure under the 2025 Rules

crm_mandate.value: CAR Section 8, Series F, Part II
CASR Part 119 reg 119.175, with the Part 121/133/135/91 suite commenced 2 December 2021
crm_mandate.note: Both levels operative; the apparent contradiction between briefs was two partial descriptions.

Searched across three rounds and not established. The absence is the finding, and must be rendered as a failed search rather than as a negative finding about Russian regulation. Adoption appears operator-driven and ICAO-aligned, but that characterisation itself rests only on Russian-language blogs and is not usable.

instrument.note: The instrument text has not been read; the tier is corrected from an earlier self-contradicting 'primary-verified' claim.

cvr_disclosure_bar.value: Standard 5.12 restricts use of investigation records for purposes other than accident investigation
